questions.scenario: Mom is looking for her keys before going to work.
questions.question:
Mom: I can't find my keys. Where are they?
Son: Look! ___________________
options: it is on the big table
questions.explanation: 問句為 Where are they?，代名詞為 they，對應 are。鑰匙在桌面上方使用 on。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 keys 視為單數 (it) 或搞混 on 與 in 的差異。

questions.scenario: Two brothers are playing a treasure hunt game.
questions.question:
Older brother: Where is the missing toy car?
Younger brother: ___________________
questions.explanation: toy car 是單數，使用 It is。表示在床底下的空間使用 under 且需定冠詞 the。
questions.commonMisconception: 漏掉定冠詞 the。

questions.scenario: Alice sees her pet sleeping inside a cozy box.
questions.question:
Alice: Where's the cat?
Dad: Shh. ___________________
questions.explanation: 單隻貓。睡在箱子『裡面』使用 in。
questions.commonMisconception: 空間介係詞 in 與 on 混淆。

questions.scenario: A teacher is asking about a picture of birds.
questions.question:
Teacher: Where are the birds?
Student: ___________________
options: It is on the big tree.
It is in the big tree.
questions.explanation: birds 為複數，需用 They are 回答。外來的鳥停在樹枝中習慣用 in the tree。
questions.commonMisconception: 被中文『在樹上』干擾而選 on。

questions.scenario: Mike is helping his grandmother find her glasses.
questions.question:
Grandma: I can't find my reading glasses.
Mike: Let me help you. ___________________
questions.explanation: glasses (眼鏡) 是恆複數名詞，應使用 Where are they?。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 glasses 理解為單數 it。

questions.scenario: Two students looking for a lost basketball.
questions.question:
Student A: ___________________
Student B: It's under the teacher's desk.
questions.explanation: 根據回答 under (在...下面)，應問 Where (哪裡)。
questions.commonMisconception: Wh- 疑問詞義掌握不清。

questions.question:
Dad: Where is the red pen?
Mom: ___________________
questions.explanation: 筆放在筆袋裡面用 in。且 pencil case 前需加 the。
questions.commonMisconception: 漏掉定冠詞 the。

questions.question:
Sister: Where is the treasure box?
Brother: ___________________
options: They are in a big rocks.
questions.explanation: treasure box 是單數用 It's。強調位置在石頭下。
questions.commonMisconception: 冠詞與名詞不一致 (a big rocks)。

questions.scenario: Tom wants to play a game.
questions.question:
Tom: Mom, where's my toy?
Mom: ___________________
Tom: Oh, I see it! It's next to the books.
questions.explanation: Mom 提供猜測用問句 Is it...。
questions.commonMisconception: 誤用 Be 動詞搭配 (It are)。

questions.scenario: The tiger is looking for the monkey.
questions.question:
Tiger: Where is the monkey hiding?
Monkey: Haha! I am __________________ the box.
questions.explanation: 躲在盒子裡面用 in。選項 B 會被看到。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合『躲藏』的情境選擇正確介係詞。

questions.question: Which word has the /ʌ/ sound like in 'bus'?
questions.explanation: bus 與 under 開頭均發短音 /ʌ/。其餘選項發 /ju/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法區別 u 的短音與半母音前綴。

questions.scenario: A hat is on a desk.
questions.question:
A: Where is the hat?
B: __________________ the desk. Next to the book.
questions.explanation: 單數 hat 配 It is。在桌面使用 on。
questions.commonMisconception: 代名詞單複數對應失敗。

questions.question:
A: __________________ my markers?
B: They are in your bag.
questions.explanation: 由回答 they are (複數) 與袋子位置反推問句。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略複數代名詞的指示功能。

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'rug'?
questions.explanation: -ug 結尾具有相同押韻。選項 B 母音不同。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意母音對押韻的決定作用。

questions.scenario: A cat is under a chair.
questions.question:
A: Look! Where is the cat?
B: It is __________________ the chair. You can't see its face.
questions.explanation: 看不見臉代表躲在下面下。選項 B 會看得到臉。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略後半句視覺提示。

questions.question:
A: Are the pencils __________________ the box?
B: No, they are next to the box.
questions.explanation: 通常先問是否在裡面使用 in。回答否定後指出確切位置。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合對話邏輯選配介係詞。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'u' at the end of sound.
questions.question: Which word rhyme with 'sun'?
questions.explanation: sun 與 run 具有韻腳 -un。其餘各項韻腳不同。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆短母音 /ʌ/ 與 /æ/。

questions.scenario: Pointing at a doll on the sofa.
questions.question:
A: Where is the doll?
B: __________________ the sofa. Look there!
questions.explanation: 玩偶在沙發面上用 on。單數對應 It is。
questions.commonMisconception: 錯用介係詞 in 於平面家具。

questions.question:
A: Is the book under the chair?
B: __________________. It's in my bag.
questions.explanation: 在袋子裡代表不在椅子下。單數主詞對應 isn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看見後文位置導正。

questions.question: Which word has a DIFFERENT vowel sound?
questions.explanation: cute 是長母音 /u/。其餘均為短母音 /ʌ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法辨識字尾 e 對母音產生的影響。

questions.question:
A: Where are the kittens?
B: They are __________________ the big box.
questions.explanation: 在箱子旁邊正確用法 next to。選項 B (at) 太籠統。
questions.commonMisconception: 漏掉 next to 的固定搭配。

questions.scenario: A bird next to a house.
questions.question:
A: Is the bird in the house?
B: No, __________________ the house.
questions.explanation: 否定後給予正確位置。選項 A 邏輯正確且文法通順。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合否定句型導向正確位置描述。

questions.question: In the word 'under', the sound of 'u' is ___________.
questions.explanation: under 的 u 發短母音 /ʌ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法將發音術語與具體單字對應。

questions.question:
A: __________________ the balls?
B: They're on the chair.
questions.explanation: balls 複數。選項 B 為單數縮寫。
questions.commonMisconception: 在問句中忘記使用 are 對應複數主詞。

questions.scenario: Pointing at a star on a Christmas tree.
questions.question:
A: Look! The star is __________________ the tree.
B: It is yellow and bright.
questions.explanation: 裝飾星在樹冠層表面用 on。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法分辨物品與樹木的空間表裡關係。

questions.question: Which word has the /ʌ/ sound?
questions.explanation: tub 是短音 /ʌ/。選項 B 是長音 /u/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法預測短母音管位。

questions.question:
A: __________________ my shoe?
B: It's under the bed.
questions.explanation: shoe 單數對應 is。選項 B 為複數用法。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略單數鞋子與複數鞋組的代名詞差異。

questions.question:
A: Where's Tom?
B: He is __________________ his room. Sleeping.
questions.explanation: 在房間裡面用 in。
questions.commonMisconception: 對大空間內的使用直覺不穩。

questions.question: Choose the word with same sound as 'bus'.
questions.explanation: bus 與 duck 均包含 /ʌ/ 音位。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆英文短母音的高低位聽感。

questions.scenario: Final location: Birds in the sky.
questions.question: Look! The birds are __________________ the sky.
questions.explanation: 在天空中慣用 in the sky。
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣性在天空這種平面直覺中選 on。

questions.scenario: Two students are drawing an alien on the blackboard.
questions.question:
Mia: Look at the alien's face! What are these?
Leo: ___________________
options: It is its big two eyes.
questions.explanation: What are these? 詢問複數物品，必須以 They are... 回答。選項 B 誤用單數代名詞 It is。
questions.commonMisconception: 對指示代名詞單複數不敏感，將複數 They 搭配 is。

questions.scenario: A doctor is checking a robot's body parts in the lab.
questions.question:
Doctor: Let's check the arms. Are these your arms?
Robot: ___________________
options: Yes, they are. They are my arms.
No, these isn't. These are arms.
No, they aren't. They is arms.
Yes, it is. It is my long arm.
questions.explanation: 問句 Are these...? 詢問複數物品，簡答須為 Yes, they are.。
questions.commonMisconception: 在簡化回答時忘記將 these 轉換為代名詞 they。

questions.scenario: Mom and Tim are packing a bag for a picnic.
questions.question:
Mom: What is this?
Tim: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句 What is this? 是詢問單數物品，必須以 It is... 回答單數名詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法正確反射相對應的單複數回答句型。

questions.scenario: A boy finds some weird things under his bed.
questions.question:
Boy: Mom! Look! What are these?
Mom: Don't touch them! ___________________
options: It is an old dirty sock.
questions.explanation: 針對 What are these? 的複數提問，回答需使用 They are。
questions.commonMisconception: 忘記指示代名詞後方要跟著正確的單複數 Be 動詞。

questions.scenario: In art class, the teacher is pointing at a student's painting.
questions.question:
Teacher: Are those your ears, monster?
Student: ___________________
options: No, they aren't. They is my eyes
Yes, they are. They are my ears.
No, it isn't. It is my big eyes.
Yes, those is. Those is my ears.
questions.explanation: Are those...? 的肯定回答為 Yes, they are.。
questions.commonMisconception: 在複數否定回答中錯配 Be 動詞。

questions.scenario: Andy and his sister are playing a guessing game with their hands.
questions.question:
Sister: Close your eyes. What are these in my hands?
Andy: ___________________
options: It is a small red markers.
questions.explanation: What are these...? 回答必須是 They are 加上複數名詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 冠詞 a/an 與字尾 s 複數同時出現。

questions.scenario: The pet shop owner is showing Lily some animals.
questions.question:
Lily: They are so cute! Are they dogs?
Owner: ___________________
options: No, they isn't. They are cat.
Yes, it is. It is small dogs.
No, they aren't. They are cats.
Yes, they are. They are cat.
questions.explanation: Are they...? 的回答必須對稱。選項 A 前後一致。
questions.commonMisconception: 名詞複數忘記加上 s，或是代名詞 they 搭配 isn't。

questions.scenario: At the zoo, a little boy is pointing at something tall.
questions.question:
Boy: Look at the long legs! _______________
Dad: Yes, they are giraffes.
questions.explanation: 從回答 Yes, they are giraffes. 可知問句必須是複數型態。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從回答的主詞和 Be 動詞反推問句的正確型態。

questions.scenario: Mary's brother takes something from her pencil case.
questions.question:
Mary: Hey! What is that?
Brother: ___________________
Mary: Give it back!
questions.explanation: What is that? 提問單數，必須以 It is... 回答。
questions.commonMisconception: 未能區分 that (單數) 與 those (複數)。

questions.scenario: During a magic show, the magician pulls things from a hat.
questions.question:
Magician: What are these? Are they rabbits?
Boy: ___________________
options: Yes, they are. They is white rabbits.
No, it isn't. It is a white bird.
No, they aren't. They are white birds.
Yes, these is. These are white rabbits.
questions.explanation: 因有 these 和 they 提示複數，回答必須是 No, they aren't.
questions.commonMisconception: 未注意英文句型對應的 They are 複數規則。

questions.question:
A: Look! What are those?
B: __________________. They are high.
questions.explanation: 遠處複數 what are those 應以 They are 回答且名詞加 s。
questions.commonMisconception: 忘記複數名詞後綴 s。

questions.question:
A: Are these your markers?
B: __________________. They're my sister's markers.
questions.explanation: 描述是別人的東西，代表否定。對應 Are these 的正確簡答。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略說明句 (sister's) 的否定提示功能。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Hard c and k sounds.
questions.question: Which word has the same beginning /k/ sound as 'cap'?
questions.explanation: cap 的 c 與 king 的 k 均發硬音 /k/。其餘選項發軟音 /s/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合不同字母發出相同音位的情形。

questions.scenario: Asking about something on a friend's head.
questions.question:
A: Is that a new hat?
B: __________________. It is a red cap.
questions.explanation: 帽子的認同回答。選項 B 為否定與後面敘述矛盾。
questions.commonMisconception: 對 hat 與 cap 的類別認同出現邏輯跳躍。

questions.scenario: Identifying body parts of a doll.
questions.question:
Child: Look! These are hands. Are these feet?
Mom: No, __________________. They are arms.
questions.explanation: 否定複數回答。選項 B 錯用單數；選項 C 動詞錯位。
questions.commonMisconception: 在具體部位辨識中錯選代名詞。

questions.question:
A: What are __________________ in the sky?
B: They are stars.
questions.explanation: 天空遠且複數 stars，選 those。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合空間距離選用 correctly 指示詞。

questions.question: Which word rhyme with 'rock'?
questions.explanation: rock 與 clock 均發短母音 /ɑk/。其餘選項母音不同。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法區別字母 c 在不同位置的組合發音。

questions.question:
A: What is that?
B: __________________. It is very pretty.
questions.explanation: 對單數 that 的正確回答。選項 B 錯用複數；選項 D 漏冠詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 遺漏單數可數名詞前的冠詞 a。

questions.scenario: Asking about many objects in a box.
questions.question:
A: Are __________________ in the box apples?
B: Yes, they are. They are red.
questions.explanation: 由回答 they correspond 推論問句應為複數。選 those 表示稍遠距離。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從空間關係推導出遠近指示詞的差異。

questions.question: In which word does 'c' sound like /s/?
questions.explanation: nice 字尾的 c 發軟音 /s/。選項 B, C, D 均發硬音 /k/。
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道字尾 e 會促使 c 改發軟音。

questions.question:
A: What is this?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 問什麼東西 (What) 應回答該物名。
questions.commonMisconception: 聽到疑問句就想回答 Yes/No。

questions.question:
A: Are those pencils under the book?
B: __________________. They are erasers.
questions.explanation: 後敘 erasers 證明前面為否定。複數主詞對應 aren't。
questions.commonMisconception: 被複數名詞混淆而選成肯定的 Yes。

questions.question: Which word has the hard /k/ sound?
questions.explanation: cake 的 c 發硬音 /k/。其餘選項均發軟音 /s/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法區別 c 在不同母音前的發音規律。

questions.scenario: Pointing to airplanes far in the sky.
questions.question: A: Look! __________________ are airplanes.
questions.explanation: 遠處且複數，選 Those。
questions.commonMisconception: 在遠距離複數情境中錯選 These。

questions.scenario: Asking for name of a strange fruit.
questions.question:
A: __________________?
B: It's a papaya.
questions.explanation: 根據回答 It's (單數) 反推問句。
questions.commonMisconception: 由代名詞 It 反推問句結構。

questions.scenario: Two things in a small box.
questions.question:
A: What are these in the box?
B: __________________. They are sweet.
questions.explanation: 針對 what are these 的正確複數回覆。
questions.commonMisconception: 複數 Be 動詞後的名詞忘了加 s。

questions.question: Choose the word with the /k/ sound.
questions.explanation: candy 發硬音 /k/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合字母組合預測發音。

questions.question:
Student: Are those markers, Teacher?
Teacher: No, __________________. They are pens.
questions.explanation: 否定複數對稱回答。選項 B 語法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 人稱與縮寫搭配混亂。

questions.question: Look at my hands. __________________ are my fingers.
questions.explanation: 手上近距離且 fingers 為複數，選 These。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法正確判斷對應的近距離指示詞。

questions.scenario: Two friends are having a snack after school.
questions.question:
Tom: Do you like apples?
Mary: ___________________
Tom: Okay, here's a banana for you.
options: No, I don't. I like sweet bananas.
Yes, I am. I like red sweet apple.
Yes, I do. I like red sweet apple.
No, I am not. I like sweet banana.
questions.explanation: 依據 Tom 給香蕉的動作可知 Mary 不愛蘋果。問句為 Do you...?，否定回答為 No, I don't.。選項 B 與 D 錯用 Be 動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 Do you...? 的回答誤用為 I am / I am not。

questions.scenario: A mother is asking her son about fruit.
questions.question:
Mother: Do you like oranges, Jimmy?
Jimmy: ___________________
options: Yes, I do. I like oranges.
No, I don't. I like a orange
No, I am not. I like orange.
Yes, I am. I like an orange.
questions.explanation: Do you 提問，肯定簡答需為 Yes, I do.。表示喜好事物用複數型 (oranges)。選項 B, D 錯用 Be 動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 被中文直接理解干擾而漏掉複數 s。

questions.scenario: Picking up fruits at the supermarket.
questions.question:
Dad: Look at these fruits. ___________________
Daughter: No, I don't. I like grapes.
questions.explanation: 從 I don't 反推問句由 Do 開頭。主詞為 you 搭配 Do。其餘文法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從回答的助動詞逆推問句系統。

questions.question:
Kevin: I like hamburgers. How about you?
Lisa: ___________________
questions.explanation: 表達喜好使用 Subject + like + Noun(s)。種類名稱需用複數。選項 B, D 贅加 am。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 am 與 like 疊加使用 (I am like...)。

questions.scenario: Checking the fridge for a snack.
questions.question:
Brother: Do you want a banana?
Sister: __________________
options: No, I don't. I am bananas.
Yes, I am. I like banana.
questions.explanation: 正面接受提議且敘述愛好。選項 B 語意矛盾；選項 D 語法破碎。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合對話上下文因果關係。

questions.question: Which word rhyme with 'cap'?
questions.explanation: cap 與 map 均具相同尾音組合 -ap。選項 A 為對話單字但韻腳不同。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆英文韻腳的範圍判斷。

questions.question:
Amy: ___________________
Betty: Yes, I do. Let's eat them together.
questions.explanation: 回答 Yes, I do 代表問句為 Do you like...? 且名詞複數。選項 B, D 錯用 Be 動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 主詞與助動詞搭配錯誤。

questions.question:
A: Does the monkey like bananas?
B: Yes, __________________. Look at it!
questions.explanation: Does it 提問對應 it does。選項 B 助動詞錯配；選項 D 數值不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 忘記第三人稱單數對應 does。

questions.question:
Dad: Do you like papayas?
Jane: ___________________
Dad: Okay, how about an apple then?
options: Yes, I do. I like papayas.
No, I don't. I like apples.
questions.explanation: 父親改供蘋果暗示先前回答為否定。選項 C 語法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略對話上下文的轉折邏輯。

questions.question: Which word has the same beginning sound as 'papaya'?
questions.explanation: papaya 與 pig 均以 /p/ 開頭。選項 B 為 /b/。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆清濁音 /p/ 與 /b/ 的聽感。

questions.question:
A: Do you like these red apples?
B: __________________. They are very sweet.
questions.explanation: 很甜 (very sweet) 暗示愛。對應 Do you 的正確答語。
questions.commonMisconception: 見到 sweet 卻在否定項糾結。

questions.question: Boy: I want some __________________.
questions.explanation: some 之後接複數名詞。選項 B 為單數；選項 D 冠詞與複數衝突。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略 some 的量化要求。

questions.question: Which word has the same 'L' sound as 'like'?
questions.explanation: like 與 lemon 均以流音 /l/ 開頭。選項 B 為 /r/。
questions.commonMisconception: 分辨流音 /l/ 與捲舌音 /r/ 的發音障礙。

questions.question:
A: __________________?
B: No, I don't. I like oranges.
questions.explanation: 根據回答 No, I don't 反推問句由 Do 開頭。
questions.commonMisconception: 助動詞錯誤配對 (Are you like)。

questions.question:
A: I'm purple. I'm small. Do you like me?
B: You are __________________! Yes, I like you.
questions.explanation: 紫色且小粒 (purple and small) 是葡萄特徵。其餘選項顏色不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合外觀描述識別正確單字。

questions.question: The G in 'grape' sounds like in __________.
questions.explanation: grape 的 g 發硬音 /g/。其餘選項發軟音 /dʒ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法辨識 g 在不同母音前的硬軟轉換。

questions.scenario: Recap: What time? (Wait, U4 Theme is Like).
questions.question:
A: __________________ like bananas?
B: Yes, she does.
questions.explanation: 回答 she does 證明問句主詞為 she 且搭配 Does。
questions.commonMisconception: 三單主詞搭配語法模糊。

questions.question: A: He likes pears. Do you __________________ pears, too?
questions.explanation: 助動詞 Do 之後接原形動詞 like。選項 B 為誤配第三人稱動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 在助動詞句型中仍進行動詞變化。

questions.question: Which fruit starts with the same sound as 'monkey'?
questions.explanation: monkey 與 mango 均以鼻音 /m/ 開頭。
questions.commonMisconception: 首音聽覺辨識不對位。

questions.question:
A: I'm yellow and long. Monkeys like me. What am I?
B: You are a __________________.
questions.explanation: 黃、長、猴子愛是香蕉的標籤特徵。
questions.commonMisconception: 語意連結失敗。

questions.scenario: Asking for preferences between two things.
questions.question:
A: __________________ like milk?
B: No, I don't. I like juice.
questions.explanation: 回答 I don't 鎖定 Do you 開頭。選項 B 為最常見文法迷思。
questions.commonMisconception: 在詢問愛好情境中錯用 Be 動詞。

questions.question:
A: Do you like sweet oranges?
B: Yes, I do. __________________
questions.explanation: 複數 oranges 對應 They are。選項 B 單數不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 代名詞轉換失據。

questions.question: Which word has the /æ/ sound?
questions.explanation: apple 與 cat 均含有短母音 /æ/。選項 B 為 /ɑ/ 音。
questions.commonMisconception: 母音發音微小細節混淆。

questions.question: My sister __________________ sweet grapes.
questions.explanation: 三單主詞 sister 需使用動詞 likes。選項 B 缺少 s。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到主詞是單數人稱。

questions.question:
A: What fruit do you like?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 問 What 開頭需回答具體物。選項 B, C 格式不對。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 Wh- 疑問句與 Yes/No 判斷句答法混淆。

questions.question: Choose the DIFFERENT beginning sound.
questions.explanation: bear 為濁音 /b/，其餘均為清音 /p/。
questions.commonMisconception: 分辨不清清濁對偶音位。

questions.question:
A: Do you like these big oranges?
B: Yes, I do. __________________ together!
questions.explanation: 提議一起做某事用 Let's + 原形動詞。選項 B, C 語法全錯。
questions.commonMisconception: 祈使句型基礎薄弱。

questions.question:
A: Do dogs like apples?
B: No, __________________.
questions.explanation: 複數 dogs 對應 they don't。選項 B 人稱不對；選項 C 語法非標準答法。
questions.commonMisconception: 在提問物種群體時錯用單數代名詞 it。

questions.question: Wait, which word rhyme with 'like'?
questions.explanation: like 與 bike 均發長母音及尾音組合 /aɪk/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法偵測相同的長母音韻腳。

questions.question:
A: Apples are red. Bananas are yellow.
B: I __________________ all of them!
questions.explanation: 表達主觀情緒使用 like。其餘選項導致身份錯認 (我是所有水果)。
questions.commonMisconception: 語意邏輯遺失。

questions.scenario: At the park, Peter and Ben are talking about sports.
questions.question:
Peter: Can you swim, Ben?
Ben: ___________________
options: Yes, I am. I can swim.
No, I don't. I can swim.
No, I can't. I can't swim.
Yes, you are. You can swim.
questions.explanation: 問句以 Can you...? 結尾，簡答時必須對應使用 can 或 can't，並且主詞要轉換為 I。選項 A 和 B 使用了錯誤的 Be 動詞或 do 助動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 被『Yes, I am.』的口語習慣干擾，忘記助動詞 Can 必須與 can / can't 對應。

questions.scenario: Emma is asking about Leo's talents for the school talent show.
questions.question:
Emma: Look at the piano. Can you play the piano?
Leo: ___________________
options: No, I don't. I can't play the piano.
Yes, I can. I can play the piano.
Yes, I am. I can play the piano.
No, you can't. You can play the piano.
questions.explanation: 問句是 Can you...?，正面回答需為 Yes, I can.。選項 B 誤用了 Be 動詞 am，選項 C 誤用了助動詞 don't。
questions.commonMisconception: 在簡答中誤將 can 替換為 am 或 don't。

questions.scenario: Two friends are watching a bird in the sky.
questions.question:
Anna: The bird is fast. Can it fly?
Sam: ___________________
options: No, it isn't. It can't fly up high.
Yes, it can. It can fly up high.
Yes, it is. It can fly up high.
No, it doesn't. It can fly up high.
questions.explanation: 主詞是 it (the bird)，助動詞為 can，所以肯定回答必須是 Yes, it can.。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 Be 動詞 (is) 與助動詞 (can) 混用。

questions.scenario: During P.E. class, the teacher is asking the students about their skills.
questions.question:
Teacher: Can you and Tim jump rope?
Student: ___________________
options: Yes, we can. We can jump rope well.
No, we aren't. We can't jump rope well.
Yes, they are. They can jump rope well.
No, you don't. You can't jump rope well.
questions.explanation: 問句中的主詞是 you and Tim (你們)，回答時必須切換為第一人稱複數 we (我們)，並且搭配助動詞 can。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略了『you and Tim』是複數『你們』。

questions.scenario: Amy's dog is running super fast in the yard.
questions.question:
Jack: Your dog is very cute. Can he catch a ball?
Amy: ___________________
options: Yes, he is. He can catch a ball.
No, he can't. He can't catch a ball.
Yes, he does. He can catch a ball.
No, it doesn't. It can catch a ball.
questions.explanation: 問句主詞是 he，助動詞 Can。選項 A 誤用 is，選項 B 誤用 does。選項 C 是正確的否定簡答。
questions.commonMisconception: 未對齊問答中的助動詞 Can。

questions.scenario: The children are talking about their grandfather's secret talent.
questions.question:
Lily: My grandpa is eighty years old.
Tom: Wow! ___________________
Lily: No, he can't.
questions.explanation: 根據助理回答的 No, he can't. 反推問句必須以 Can 開頭。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略回答中的 can't 提示而錯選 Is he 或 Does he。

questions.scenario: A brother and sister are playing by the swimming pool.
questions.question:
Brother: Let's run by the pool!
Sister: No! You ___________________
options: aren't run by the clear pool.
doesn't run by the clear pool.
can't run by the clear pool.
isn't run by the clear pool.
questions.explanation: 表達『不能』時應使用 can't。選項 B、D 使用 Be 動詞搭配原形動詞屬於嚴重文法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 Be 動詞否定與一般動詞直接堆疊。

questions.question: Which word has the /k/ sound like in 'can'?
questions.explanation: can 的 c 發 /k/。kite 的 k 亦發 /k/。選項 B, C, D 的 c 發 /s/。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆字母 c 的 Hard /k/ 與 Soft /s/ 發音。

questions.scenario: Sally is drawing a picture of a cute monkey on the whiteboard.
questions.question:
Mark: It's a nice monkey. Can it climb trees?
Sally: ___________________
options: No, it doesn't. it climb trees.
Yes, it is. It can climb trees.
Yes, it can. It can climb trees.
No, it isn't. It can't climb trees.
questions.explanation: 問句主詞 it，助動詞 Can，肯定回答為 Yes, it can.。
questions.commonMisconception: 對助動詞 Can 提問回答 it is 或 it doesn't。

questions.scenario: The mother is asking her daughter about her new friends from school.
questions.question:
Mother: Can your friends ride a bike?
Daughter: ___________________
options: No, they aren't. They can't ride a bike.
Yes, we do. We can ride a bike.
Yes, they are. They can ride a bike.
No, they can't. They can't ride a bike.
questions.explanation: your friends 是複數，代名詞為 they。由 Can 提問，否定回答必須是 No, they can't.。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 your friends 誤認為 we，或是回答時錯用 Be 動詞。

questions.question:
A: Can you swim like a fish?
B: __________________. I am a good swimmer.
questions.explanation: 良好泳者暗示肯定回答。選項 C 助動詞不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 反射性使用 I am 卻忽略問句是 Can。

questions.scenario: Seeing a frog in the pond.
questions.question:
A: Look! A frog. Can it jump?
B: __________________. It can jump high.
questions.explanation: 青蛙會跳是常識。對應 Can it 的正確簡答為 Yes, it can.。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 Be 動詞與助動詞的簡答對應。

questions.question: Which word has the same beginning sound as 'kite'?
questions.explanation: king 的 k 發 /k/，與 kite 相同。選項 C, D 的 k 在 n 前不發音。
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道 k 在 n 前不發音 (Silent k)。

questions.scenario: A brother asking his sister for help.
questions.question:
Brother: __________________?
Sister: Yes, I can. Let's sing together.
questions.explanation: 根據回答『Yes, I can...』反推問句。選項 B 是雙動詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法由簡答還原正確問句結構。

questions.question: Which word has the /s/ sound (Soft c)?
questions.explanation: city 的 c 在 i 前發 /s/。其餘選項發 /k/。
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道 c 在 e, i, y 前通常發軟音 /s/。

questions.question:
A: Can the kitten climb the chair?
B: __________________. It is too small.
questions.explanation: 太小了 (too small) 導致無法爬上去。選項 C 助動詞不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略後半句的生理限制條件。

questions.scenario: Pointing at a plane in the sky.
questions.question:
A: Look! Can it fly fast?
B: __________________. It is a jet.
questions.explanation: 噴射機 (jet) 飛很快。選項 C 助動詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 見到 it is 就想選 Yes, it is 回答 Can it。

questions.question: Which word has the /k/ sound at the END?
questions.explanation: duck 的 ck 發 /k/ 尾音。其餘選項無此發音。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法辨識 ck 組合發出的單一 /k/ 音。

questions.scenario: Asking about a group of students.
questions.question:
A: __________________?
B: No, they can't. They can't dance well.
questions.explanation: 由回答『No, they can't』反推問句。選項 B 人稱單數不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略複數代名詞 they 的對應需求。

questions.question:
A: Can a pig fly?
B: __________________. It has no wings.
questions.explanation: 豬沒翅膀不會飛。選項 B 邏輯錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 常識判斷正確但代名詞與助動詞組合選錯。

questions.scenario: A girl is helping her baby brother.
questions.question:
A: Can he jump?
B: __________________. He can't even walk.
questions.explanation: 連走路都不會，當然不會跳。選項 C 助動詞語法不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從『不會走』推論『不會跳』的能力階層。

questions.question: In which word does 'c' sound like /k/?
questions.explanation: picnic 中的 c 全發 /k/。其餘選項均發軟音 /s/。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略 c 位於字尾或字中時的發音規律。

questions.scenario: Talking about things in a storybook.
questions.question:
A: Can the big bear run?
B: __________________. It is very fast.
questions.explanation: 很跑很快，故選肯定。選項 C 人稱錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 主詞是 bear (it)，卻習慣性回答 Yes, I can。

questions.question:
Child: Can I have a cookie?
Mom: No, you __________________. It's dinner time.
questions.explanation: 拒絕許可用 can't。其餘選項語法不符許可情境。
questions.commonMisconception: 在許可權限語境中錯用狀態否定語 (am not)。

questions.scenario: Two students discussing a robotic dog.
questions.question:
A: Can it sing like a person?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 機器狗會唱歌的可能性通常被否定。對應 Can it 的正確簡答。選項 B 助動詞錯配。
questions.commonMisconception: 在科幻情境中迷失基本的助動詞對稱規則。

questions.question:
A: Can it jump now?
B: __________________. It is sleeping.
questions.explanation: 睡覺時不能跳。選項 C 助動詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合睡覺狀態推論活動能力的暫時缺失。

questions.question: The sound of 'c' in 'cool' is the same as in __________.
questions.explanation: cool 的 c 發 /k/。candy 亦同。其餘選項為軟音 /s/。
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道 c 在 a, o, u 前發硬音 /k/。

questions.question:
Coach: You are strong. Can you jump over the box?
Student: __________________. Watch me!
questions.explanation: 『看我的』(Watch me) 暗示肯定回答。選項 C 助動詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 被 Watch me 的自信語氣震懾而忘了檢查文法一致性。

questions.question: Elephants __________________ fly. They are too heavy.
questions.explanation: 大象太重了不能飛。填入表示『不能』的助動詞。選項 C 描述慣常行為不合情境。
questions.commonMisconception: 語意了解但錯選描述習慣的助動詞 don't。
